content_data.project_title: Unified Accessibility Framework for Cross-Platform Streaming
content_data.project_description: Development of a comprehensive accessibility infrastructure to ensure WCAG 2.2 AAA compliance across web, mobile, and smart TV applications. This framework will standardize accessibility features including adaptive audio descriptions, customizable subtitle rendering, and assistive navigation controls.
content_data.timeline: 14 months with Phase 1: Architecture & Core Components (months 1-5), Phase 2: Platform Integration (months 6-10), Phase 3: Testing & Optimization (months 11-14)
objectives: Create reusable accessibility patterns and documentation for future development
Reduce accessibility-related technical debt by implementing unified component library
Establish automated accessibility testing pipeline integrated into CI/CD workflows
deliverables: Assistive navigation SDK for voice control and keyboard-only interfaces
Enhanced subtitle rendering system with customization options
Comprehensive technical documentation and implementation guides
Core accessibility framework library with platform-specific adapters
Automated accessibility testing suite and CI/CD integration
success_metrics: Automated test coverage for accessibility features exceeding 90%
Zero critical accessibility compliance violations in regulatory audits
Reduction in accessibility-related bug reports by minimum 75%
User satisfaction score improvement of 40% among assistive technology users
Development velocity increase of 30% for accessibility feature implementation
100% WCAG 2.2 AAA compliance certification across web, iOS, Android, and smart TV platforms
